name: Asheville
summary: A mountain arts-and-beer town wrapped around America's largest house, with the Blue Ridge Parkway and the highest peak in the East at the door.

lodging.name: The Omni Grove Park Inn
lodging.blurb: A 1913 arts-and-crafts landmark over the city, with a famous cave spa.

foodMustTry.name: A craft-beer flight
foodMustTry.blurb: Asheville has more breweries per capita than almost anywhere — 'Beer City.'

item.title: Biltmore Estate
item.blurb: George Vanderbilt's 250-room French château and its gardens, winery, and 8,000 acres — a full day.

days.label: Day 166 — The Blue Ridge & Mount Mitchell
days.summary: The parkway and the roof of the East.

item.title: Blue Ridge Parkway & Mount Mitchell
item.blurb: Drive the most scenic stretch of the Parkway to the highest peak east of the Mississippi (6,684 ft).

days.label: Day 167 — Free Day
days.summary: Breweries, the River Arts District, or a hike. Options below.

freeMenu.title: River Arts District & downtown
freeMenu.blurb: Working studios in old warehouses, plus downtown's galleries and taprooms.

freeMenu.title: DuPont State Forest waterfalls
freeMenu.blurb: A trio of easy-to-reach waterfalls (some seen in The Hunger Games).

days.label: Day 168 — Down to Charlotte
days.summary: Out of the mountains to the Queen City.

commute.scenicNote: Southeast off the Blue Ridge to North Carolina's biggest city.
